correctness.rationale: The complement has minimum degree N-3, giving a sharp lower bound. A direct first-force test and two-white cleanup prove the exact optimum triples. Distance-two pair incidence counts give N(N-4) vertices and the pair intersection multiplicity table g=2,N-3,4,3,4, hence N(binom(N,2)-11) edges. Unique-core/dual-core classification and the sole length-10 antipodal collision yield the four multiplicities. Explicit three-step paths and disjoint witness establish diameter three for all cycle unions of girth at least nine. The package verifier computes actual zero forcing from adjacency for fourteen test families.

value.rationale: The degree distribution of an optimum-configuration exchange graph detects exactly the number of ten-cycle components of its underlying forbidden 2-factor. Ordinary minimum cardinality, number of optimum states, exchange edge count, and diameter all fail to see this invariant. This is a motivated infinite-family structural separation and an exact reconstruction of a natural component count, not an arbitrary restricted computation.
